headline: Katz declares demolition ledger (60+ villages, 23,000 homes, ~700 sq km zone, 200,000 displaced)
dek: Katz: any rocket or drone fire at Israel would prompt strikes on Beirut's southern suburbs. If Hezbollah joined an Iranian attack on Israel, Israel could seize more territory toward Nabatieh and the Litani River — residents evacuated, seized territory becoming a permanent part of Israel's…
sources: Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz (statement, via Shafaq News/NNA); Lebanon's Health Ministry (toll figures, via Shafaq)
fault_line: Deterrence or ethnic cleansing by bulldozer: 23,000 homes razed under a 'ceasefire' — who stops it? Israel's right-to-strike vs Lebanon losing land by the square kilometre.

sections.what_happened: Katz: any rocket or drone fire at Israel would prompt strikes on Beirut's southern suburbs. If Hezbollah joined an Iranian attack on Israel, Israel could seize more territory toward Nabatieh and the Litani River — residents evacuated, seized territory becoming a permanent part of Israel's 'security zone.' Israel will not withdraw from southern Lebanon until Hezbollah is disarmed nationwide. Katz's demolition ledger: Israeli forces have demolished more than 60 villages and 23,000 homes in a zone of ~700 sq km, displacing ~200,000 residents. Health Ministry: Israeli attacks have killed 4,389 and wounded 12,424 in Lebanon since March 2; overall toll since Oct 2023: 8,956 killed, 30,660 wounded (as of Oct 12). Context: Thursday's strikes continued (Marjayoun plain, al-Qantara, al-Mansouri, Nabatieh al-Fawqa, Kfar Tebnit, Wadi Zebqin, drones over Beirut) despite the June US-sponsored framework agreement.
sections.what_verified: Shafaq/NNA chain; Anadolu reporting of Thursday strikes consistent with 2100-06 record; Bangladesh Dispatch analysis on ceasefire contradiction
sections.what_disputed: Lebanese officials (Aoun, Salam, Berri) say Israel is violating the framework agreement; AJ's '40 killed during truce' vs Health Ministry '4,389 since March 2' measure different windows — do not mix
sections.why_matters: The bulldozer ledger: 60+ villages, 23,000 homes, 200,000 displaced — and Katz now says the rubble could become permanent territory if Hezbollah joins Iran's war. Map the ~700 sq km security zone against the 'ceasefire' Lebanon signed in June. Lebanon is becoming the visible invoice for the Iran war.
